skills.description: Chinese-language Linux command interpreter (Linux命令中文解释器). Explains command syntax, options, pipelines, redirects, and complex chains in Chinese. Use when: (1) user types or pastes a Linux command and asks '这是什么意思' or '解释一下', (2) user wants Chinese breakdown of command options like -r, --recursive, (3) user needs to understand complex pipelines with |, >, &&, (4) user wants to know what a command does before running it, (5) user is learning Linux and needs Chinese explanations of common tools like grep, sed, awk, find. NOT for: Windows cmd/PowerShell, SQL queries, programming language code, asking the AI to execute the command rather than explain it.
